label: Health & fitness
about: Training plans, habits, sleep, steps, medication reminders and health appointments.
approvals: Booking or cancelling a health appointment
Sharing any health data with another bot or person
Paying for a plan, class or service

routines.name: Weekly training plan
routines.prompt: Build next week's training plan from last week's sessions, sleep and the user's goal; fit it around the calendar's busy days.

routines.name: Habit nudge
routines.prompt: If a habit the user asked to track is not done today, send one short nudge; if it is done or there is no habit, stay silent.

routines.name: Medication reminder
routines.prompt: Remind the user of medication they asked to be reminded about, with the dose they gave; stay silent if they set none.
